name: ui-click
prompt: Short soft wooden button click, gentle fingertip tap on a small panel.

name: aim-tick
prompt: Very short quiet mechanical dial tick, a single ratchet click while aiming.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: Short low dull error buzz with a soft denied wooden thunk.

name: strike-soft
prompt: Gentle putter tap on a golf ball, soft plastic knock on a minigolf green.

name: strike-hard
prompt: Firm putter strike on a golf ball, sharp bright knock with a short room tail.

name: bounce-wall
prompt: Golf ball bouncing off a padded wooden minigolf wall, dull hollow knock.

name: bounce-mover
prompt: Golf ball knocking against a moving wooden obstacle, deep hollow clunk.

name: bounce-turf
prompt: Golf ball bouncing softly once on short grass turf, muted grassy thud.

name: splash
prompt: Small golf ball splashing into a garden pond, brief water plop with light droplets.

name: holed
prompt: Golf ball dropping into a metal cup, rattling around and settling with a cheerful plink.

name: capped
prompt: Short descending disappointed slide whistle, soft and apologetic.

name: round-complete
prompt: Short cheerful four-note marimba fanfare rising in pitch, warm and friendly.

name: session-complete
prompt: Bright celebratory five-note chime fanfare, triumphant finish with a gentle shimmer.

name: undo
prompt: Quick soft reverse swoosh, like a sheet of paper sliding back into place.
